### Pinhole SANS Instrument Design & Simulation Summary

#### Instrument Overview & Geometry
A 6-meter pinhole SANS instrument was constructed in McStas:
1. **Source (`source`):** Circular `Source_simple`, $R = 2\text{ cm}$, emitting uniformly in wavelength $\lambda = 6.0 \pm 0.05\text{ \AA}$, with source flux $I_0 = 10^8\text{ n/s/cm}^2/\text{sr/\AA}$. Target focusing is set to cover the first pinhole aperture.
2. **Collimation Pinholes (`pinhole1`, `pinhole2`):**
   - First pinhole aperture: $R_1 = 5\text{ mm}$ located $3.0\text{ m}$ downstream of the source.
   - Second pinhole aperture: $R_2 = 5\text{ mm}$ located $6.0\text{ m}$ downstream of the source ($3.0\text{ m}$ relative to pinhole 1).
3. **Diagnostic Beam Monitor (`mon_pinhole2`):** $2\times 2\text{ cm}$ 2D PSD monitor directly behind pinhole 2 (`restore_neutron=1`).
4. **Sample (`sample`):** `Sans_spheres` component placed $0.2\text{ m}$ downstream of pinhole 2.
   - Dimensions: $1.0\times 1.0\text{ cm}^2$ aperture ($x_{\text{width}} = y_{\text{height}} = 0.01\text{ m}$), thickness $t = 0.5\text{ cm}$ ($z_{\text{depth}} = 0.005\text{ m}$).
   - Sample parameters: Monodisperse hard spheres of radius $R = 100\text{ \AA}$, volume fraction $\Phi = 0.001$ ($0.1\%$), scattering length density contrast $\Delta\rho = 0.6\text{ fm/\AA}^3$, absorption cross-section density $\sigma_{\text{abs}} = 0.05\text{ m}^{-1}$. Focused towards the $60\times 60\text{ cm}^2$ detector at $3\text{ m}$.
5. **Beamstop (`beamstop`):** Circular absorber of radius $R_{\text{bs}} = 2.0\text{ cm}$, located $2.9\text{ m}$ downstream of the sample ($0.1\text{ m}$ in front of the main detector plane).
6. **Detector (`detector`):** 2D position-sensitive detector ($128 \times 128$ pixels), $60 \times 60\text{ cm}^2$, located $3.0\text{ m}$ behind the sample.
7. **Wavelength Monitor (`lambda_mon`):** Wavelength monitor ($100$ bins covering $5.5 - 6.5\text{ \AA}$) with matching $60 \times 60\text{ cm}^2$ acceptance positioned at the detector plane (`restore_neutron=1`).

---

#### Simulation Results (`ncount = 10,000,000`, `seed = 12345`)

| Monitor / Detector | Dimension / Range | Integrated Intensity $I$ (n/s) | Error $\pm \delta I$ (n/s) | Detected Rays ($N$) | Rel. Error |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Collimated Beam (`mon_pinhole2`)** | $2 \times 2\text{ cm}^2$ PSD | **$68.76$** | $\pm 0.10$ | $492,455$ | $0.14\%$ |
| **Main SANS Detector (`detector`)** | $60 \times 60\text{ cm}^2$ (128x128) | **$0.04481$** | $\pm 0.00023$ | $470,454$ | $0.52\%$ |
| **Wavelength Monitor (`lambda_mon`)** | $5.5 - 6.5\text{ \AA}$ | **$0.04481$** | $\pm 0.00023$ | $470,454$ | $0.52\%$ |

#### Key Simulated Observables
- **Incident Beam Intensity:** The collimated direct beam flux reaching the sample position through the two $5\text{ mm}$ radius pinholes is $68.76 \pm 0.10\text{ n/s}$.
- **Main Detector Integrated Intensity:** The total small-angle scattered neutron intensity recorded on the $60 \times 60\text{ cm}^2$ main detector (with direct beam blocked by the $2\text{ cm}$ radius beamstop) is **$0.04481 \pm 0.00023\text{ n/s}$**.
